qDef.qDef:
count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'Qlik Answers - Application'}, $(vCurrentMonth) >} [__KEY_app])
+ count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'Qlik Answers - Assistant', 'Qlik Answers (Legacy)'}, $(vCurrentMonth) >} [__KEY_assistant])
+ count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'Qlik Answers - Assistant', 'Qlik Answers (Legacy)'}, $(vCurrentMonth) >} [Knowledgebase Id])
+ if( count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'MCP'}, $(vCurrentMonth) >} [__KEY_thread_message_concat]) > 0
	,1
    ,0)

(
count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'Qlik Answers - Application'}, $(vCurrentMonth) >} [__KEY_app])
+ count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'Qlik Answers - Assistant', 'Qlik Answers (Legacy)'}, $(vCurrentMonth) >} [__KEY_assistant])
+ count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'Qlik Answers - Assistant', 'Qlik Answers (Legacy)'}, $(vCurrentMonth) >} [Knowledgebase Id])
+ if( count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'MCP'}, $(vCurrentMonth) >} [__KEY_thread_message_concat]) > 0
	,1
    ,0)
)
/
(
count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'Qlik Answers - Application'}, $(vPriorMonthMTD) >} [__KEY_app])
+ count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'Qlik Answers - Assistant', 'Qlik Answers (Legacy)'}, $(vPriorMonthMTD) >} [__KEY_assistant])
+ count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'Qlik Answers - Assistant', 'Qlik Answers (Legacy)'}, $(vPriorMonthMTD) >} [Knowledgebase Id])
+ if( count(distinct{$<[Question Source]={'MCP'}, $(vPriorMonthMTD) >} [__KEY_thread_message_concat]) > 0
	,1
    ,0)
)
-1
